fact: In May 2019 the head of land taxation and cadastre said land titles were on paper, that digitisation of newly created titles began in December 2018 (800+ done) with over 30 Niamey subdivisions digitised, and that a GIS application was the next step.
title: Dispositif institutionnel d'amélioration du climat des affaires au Niger : Le transfert de propriété : un indicateur dans la mise en œuvre des reformes engagées
